scripts.dev:js: concurrently -n vite,dx -c cyan,yellow "vite build --watch" "~/.cargo/bin/dx serve --hot-patch --features local --package showroom-web"
scripts.setups:check: bun run setups && git diff --exit-code -- bindings && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- bindings)"
scripts.types: rm -rf bindings/types && cargo test -q -p showroom-web --bin showroom-web export_bindings
scripts.types:check: bun run types && git diff --exit-code -- bindings/types && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- bindings/types)"
